_source.title: 外部库用户索引
_source.remarks.text.0: 支持外部库使用名称或关联的嘉立创 EDA 系统内用户 UUID 作为用户的唯一 ID 索引
_source.remarks.text.1: 如若希望关联嘉立创 EDA 的用户，请传入该用户的 UUID，将会自动读取用户的名称（如若用户存在）
_source.remarks.text.2: 如若仅希望显示用户名称，可以传入 `name` 字段
_source.properties.name: 用户名称
_source.properties.uuid: 嘉立创 EDA 系统内的用户 UUID

title: External library user index
remarks.text.0: Supports external libraries using a name or the associated user UUID within the EasyEDA system as the unique ID index of the user
remarks.text.1: If you want to associate with an EasyEDA user, pass in the user's UUID. The user's name will be automatically read (if the user exists)
remarks.text.2: If you only want to display the user name, you can pass in the `name` field
properties.name: User name
properties.uuid: User UUID within the EasyEDA system
